votes.motion: Adopt RDA Resolution 01 of 2024 Housing Development Loan Program (HDLP) Funding Allocation for High Opportunity Areas and Housing Development Loan Program (HDLP) Funding Allocations for GAP Financing
votes.description: Approves up to $2.7 million for affordable housing projects in high opportunity areas and up to $15.4 million in affordable housing funding allocations for gap financing, both selected through competitive NOFAs under the HDLP.

Sets the date of Tuesday, April 16, 2024 at 2 p.m. to accept public comment and consider adopting a resolution amending the final budget of the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2023-24.
